name: scene3d_capture
description: Inspect 1–4 views of the live scene without changing the user viewport. Returns annotated images and camera parameters for internal visual review; measure objects with scene3d_state. Requires the world open in the browser. @see guides_get('scene3d')

cameraId.description: Saved camera id from scene3d_state. Exclusive with position, lookAt and fov in this view.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees. Defaults to current view.

position.description: World units, like scene3d_state, not the metre rulers in the image.

shotId.description: Take id from scene3d_state; requires timeSeconds. Omit both for current scene.

timeSeconds.description: Seconds from take start, at most its duration; requires shotId.

view.description: Default perspective. Overview adds TOP, FRONT and SIDE in a 2x2 image.
